text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City Policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is recommending that the current parking prohibition on the south side of Edna Avenue, between a point 15 metres west of Dorval Road and a point 30.5 metres west of Dorval Road be rescinded to provide additional parking spaces on this segment of roadway. This provision will not affect traffic operations in this area.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times on the south side of Edna Avenue, between a point 15 metres west of Dorval Road and a point 30.5 metres west of Dorval Road. 2. Amended the existing permit parking regulation in effect from 12:01 a.m. to 7:00 a.m., daily, on the south side of Edna Avenue, between a point 30.5 metres west of Dorval Road and Indian Road, to be in effect between a point 15 metres west of Dorval Road and Indian Road.
